detail.longDescription:
My solar powered local LLM homelab today created a simple website to display my collection of restaurant dishes (I'm a foodie if you can't tell).

https://lydie.cc/foodie/

The OpenCode platform utilized both my SolarAI-V1 Unsloth server and SolarAI-V2 Strata server to create this.  The AI examined the photos to write the descriptions - I have not manually edited anything.  There are a couple small errors, but not bad as an example of raw local LLM work.

So for anyone that says local models are useless, 🖕 😆 

#selfhosted #selfhosting #hermesagent #homeassistant #homelab
